items.q: Harry came out here -- I don't remember whether it was the first or the second time he came into California... So at the time, I was playing baritone saxophone

ctx.x: You were telling me a story about how Harry Garney (PHONETIC) got the right mouthpiece.

Yes, Harry came out here -- I don't remember whether it was the first or the second time he came into California, and he seemed to be having trouble with the mouthpiece that he had because it wasn't open enough.
